artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan siting the lean_goal empty-goals trust-surface statement once in mcp-tools-guide.md's lean_goal section with the sorryAx mechanism measured locally on Lean 4.33.0-rc1, pointing lean-implementation-flow.md's Stage 4B item 5 at it without restating, deleting the one in-scope restatement from the lean extension README's capability table, and closing with a redeploy that declares __WHOLE_TREE__.

memory_candidates.content: For a source-store prose/markdown edit (a context/, rules/, or agents/ file under agent-system/extensions/**), verify-touched.sh is NOT the cheap covering check a plan should name: suite_selection_select returns __FULL_SWEEP__ for such a path, and verify-touched.sh classifies it OWED rather than no-suite-by-class, which makes it run the ENTIRE battery (measured: 98 suites, 0 suite(s) selected / 1 owed). The cheap, honest covering check for that path class is plan-format.md's __FULL_SWEEP__ sub-case (b) gate subset instead -- verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 <repo_root>, with the repository root holding .claude-extensions.json passed as TARGET, never the resolved source_dir. Note the asymmetry within one extension: an extension's own README.md DOES map to real suites (18 basenames), so a phase mixing a README edit with a context-file edit produces a MIXED selector output and must be split into separate phases for either justification to be honest.
